description: Translate, squeeze, and/or delete characters from standard input, writing to standard output.

option.name: --delete
tip: delete characters in ARRAY1, do not translate

option.name: --squeeze-repeats
tip: replace each sequence of a repeated character that is listed in the last specified ARRAY, with a single occurrence of that character

option.name: --truncate-set1
tip: first truncate ARRAY1 to length of ARRAY2
